sonnet.problem: Card 4 already asked that the Teacher calls everything under the sun 'a pursuit of the wind'. This True/False card re-asks that same fact for 1:17, and its True answer largely repeats the story card just before it (card 9).
sonnet.rule: An easy follow-up asks something new. It never re-asks the same fact. Two lines that make the same point get one question. An answer shown on one card, right or wrong, isn't used again on a later card.

sonnet.problem: This choice card asks about 2:10 ('did not deny myself'), but the story card that tells 2:10 only comes afterward, as card 11. The question jumps ahead of the telling.
sonnet.rule: Cards follow the passage in order. A choice card can look back at a verse an earlier card in the same stop told, but never jumps ahead.
